fusions.name: Pry Loose
fusions.desc: Pries at the target's guard, dealing 4 damage and leaving it 5% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Pocketed Pebble
fusions.desc: Flicks a pebble past the plates, dealing 30 damage and ignoring armour, then it leaps to 2 more enemies within 3.5 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage.

fusions.name: Clamber
fusions.desc: Steps you instantly to a point up to 6 tiles away. Using it increases your movement speed by 20% for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Sleight of Hoof
fusions.desc: Each time you inflict a condition, you regain 5 stamina. Once every 6 seconds. Your dodge chance rises by 5%.
